name: Nansen Smart Money holdings
description: Current token holdings of wallets Nansen labels as Smart Money, filtered by chain. Public x402 endpoint indexed by the BFA community; payment goes directly to Nansen. Smart Money tier, $0.05 per call. Rate limit 5 req/s and 60 req/min per paying wallet.

data.sources: Nansen's own labelled onchain dataset, sold by Nansen over its public x402 API.
data.license_statement: BFA only indexes the endpoint; the agent pays Nansen directly and Nansen's API terms apply. BFA does not resell the data.
